claims: Blackstone Inc. is the world’s largest alternative asset manager.
Blackstone Inc. has over $1.3 trillion in Assets Under Management (AUM) as of late 2025.
Blackstone Inc. specializes in real estate, private equity, credit, and infrastructure.
Blackstone Inc. was founded in 1985 by Steve Schwarzman and Peter Peterson.
Steve Schwarzman is the Chairman & CEO of Blackstone Inc.
Jon Gray is the President & COO of Blackstone Inc.
Blackstone Inc. has headquarters in New York City.
Blackstone Real Estate is the world's largest owner of commercial real estate.
Blackstone Private Equity is focused on leveraged buyouts and growth equity.
As of Q1 2026, Blackstone Inc. reported $4.36 billion in quarterly revenue.
Blackstone Inc. has a roughly $25 billion portfolio in data centers.
BREIT is Blackstone Real Estate Income Trust.
BCRED is Blackstone Private Credit Fund.
Blackstone Inc. manages 12,500 real estate assets.
